mission: A free, intensive in-person programme at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) teaching ML engineering for alignment: transformers, mechanistic interpretability, reinforcement learning/RLHF and evals. ARENA 9.0 ran 5 Oct – 6 Nov 2026, covering travel, visas, accommodation and meals. Its open-source curriculum is widely used for self-study. Founded by Callum McDougall.

key_work.title: ARENA curriculum (open source)
key_work.plain_summary: Free exercises and notebooks covering transformers from scratch, interpretability, RL/RLHF and LLM evals.

key_work.title: ARENA lecture series
key_work.plain_summary: Recorded lectures accompanying each curriculum day, e.g. intro to mechanistic interpretability and eval design.

warnings.text: Technical AI safety needs more skilled research engineers (programme rationale).

recommendations.text: Remove financial barriers so talented people can train full-time in AI safety engineering.
Teach hands-on interpretability, RLHF and evaluation skills that labs and safety orgs need.
